summary: Practise fireground assessment, team coordination and tactical planning with NFPA references. Review the course outline and learning outcomes.
lede: Advanced fire fighting training helps firefighters, brigade members and team leaders assess complex incidents and coordinate response. Participants practise incident size-up and hazard recognition, set tactical priorities, and coordinate crews, hose lines and pumps through the Incident Command System. They also develop team-readiness checks and incident plans, maintain crew accountability, and review outcomes through after-action learning.
audienceIntro: The course is designed for people who make or support fireground decisions, prepare response teams, or review operational readiness. It suits roles working with structural, industrial and facility fire response.
prerequisites: You don't need any formal entry prerequisites.
